function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content: Maaf, saya tidak memiliki data real‑time mengenai jadwal restock. Untuk mengetahui kapan warna pink akan tersedia lagi, silakan cek kembali di toko kami nanti atau beri tahu nama produk spesifik yang Anda cari. Terima kasih!

The user says: "Warna pink kapan restok kak". This is Indonesian: "When will the pink color restock?" They want to know when the pink color product will restock. We need to respond appropriately. There's no mention of a specific product. We might ask clarifying question: what product? Or we can provide general info: we don't have real-time inventory. But we can simulate a response: maybe we can use the function to search for products with keyword "pink" and see if any are out-of-stock. But we can't get restock dates. We could say we don't have that info.

We should respond politely: "Maaf, saya tidak memiliki informasi tentang tanggal restock. Silakan cek kembali nanti atau beri tahu produk spesifik." That would be appropriate.
